transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I'd like to get started on the routine check-in for 'The Last Harbor' before we lock the presentation package. I need to hear from each of you on the archive, music, and technical sides. Could we go around and share what you've found so far?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on the archive side. I reviewed an archive-license amendment received yesterday, and it confirms that this festival screening must use the Northlight Archive's 35mm print, retain the film's 1.33:1 image framing without cropping, and display the exact credit 'Restored by Northlight Archive.' I haven't entered the amendment into the festival rights tracker yet, but this directly affects the draft package — the proposed digital projection and standard 16:9 screen mask would not comply with these requirements.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue on the technical and music side. I tested the screening room with the live-score setup this morning, and the room's pit and monitoring arrangement supports only a solo piano — not the proposed string trio. Also, the commissioned score cleared for this performance is 'Tide Marks,' and I have not yet updated the technical run sheet to reflect any of this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for these critical findings. Let me make sure I have everything straight before I make my decision. Julian, the archive-license amendment requires: 35mm print from Northlight Archive, 1.33:1 image framing without cropping, and the exact credit 'Restored by Northlight Archive.' Nia, the technical and music situation is: the screening room only supports a solo piano, not the proposed string trio, and the commissioned score is 'Tide Marks.' Both of these findings directly conflict with the draft package — digital projection must become 35mm, the 16:9 mask must become 1.33:1, and the string trio must become solo piano. I also need to note that both of you mentioned items not yet entered into your respective tracking systems. Before I lock the package, can you both confirm that you will update the festival rights tracker and the technical run sheet accordingly once I issue the final decision?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Yes, Mara, I can confirm that once you issue the final decision, I will enter the archive-license amendment into the festival rights tracker, including all three requirements: the Northlight Archive 35mm print, the 1.33:1 image framing without cropping, and the exact credit 'Restored by Northlight Archive.'
transcript.speaker: A2
